_meta.notes: Day/night astronomical cycle length, day fraction, and condition mapping per DESIGN.md Part 5 T07.

cycle_length_s.notes: Full day/night planetary cycle length in seconds (60 minutes default). A 30 minute cycle made dusk pass in a few minutes, which read as the sky snapping to night.

day_fraction.notes: Fraction of cycle classified as daytime (sun above horizon)

dawn_dusk_transition_s.notes: Duration of dawn and dusk transitions in seconds

condition_mapping.notes: Mapping from weather state to T13A booster condition tokens
